description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CAPE MAY COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000414
DOCKET NO. F-002337-25
PLAINTIFF – NEWREZ LLC D/B/A SHELLPOINT MORTGAGE SERVICING
DEFENDANTS- JACQUELINE L TODD
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 17th Day OF February 2027
At 1:00 o'clock in the afternoon at the old Courthouse building located at 9 N Main Street (Route 9), in Cape May Court
House, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP OF UPPER of Ocean View, County of Cape
May and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 370, BLOCK 453.10 FKA 453
Dimensions of Lot: 150 feet wide by 168 feet long
Nearest Cross Street: NJ State Highway Route 50
OWNER OCCUPIED
Estimated upset bid amount: $228,000.00, plus any additional sums as ordered by the court.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
4 PEACH ORCHARD Road Ocean View, NJ 08230
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Cape May County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: 2026 Qtr 4 Due: 11/1/2026 $1,273.29 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 1 Due: 2/1/2027 $1,230.50 OPEN, 2027 Qtr 2
Due: 5/1/2027 $1,230.49 OPEN
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of
the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be
found in the Cape May County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or
other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own
independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over
the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The
Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any
surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that
person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the
sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $185,713.83 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and
commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Robert A. Nolan, SHERIFF
DATED: October 29, 2026
Ras Citron, LLC
130 Clinton Road, Suite 202
Fairfield, NJ 07004
973-575-0707
